title: swida walteri
intro: Swida walteri, commonly known as Walter's Alder or Black Alder, is a plant species in the heath family (Ericaceae) and is native to the mountainous regions of East Asia. The Swida walteri plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Swida walteri include treating various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal disorders due to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of Swida walteri include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
